blocks.passage:
A short business report has three parts: situation, facts, and recommendation.

First, describe the situation in one or two sentences. Then, share the main facts or numbers. Finally, say what you think we should do next.

A good report is short and clear. Use simple words, short sentences, and small numbers. If the reader finishes in two minutes with the right information, your report is a success.

items.q: What are the three parts of a short business report?
items.why: "situation, facts, and recommendation."

items.q: What do you do first?
options: Describe the situation in one or two sentences
items.why: "First, describe the situation in one or two sentences."

items.q: What is the last part?
options: What you think we should do next
items.why: "Finally, say what you think we should do next."

items.q: What kind of words and sentences should you use?
options: Simple words, short sentences, small numbers
items.why: "Use simple words, short sentences, and small numbers."

items.q: When is your report a success?
options: When the reader finishes in two minutes with the right information
When it takes an hour to read
items.why: "If the reader finishes in two minutes with the right information, your report is a success."

audio.text:
I'm writing a one-page report on client satisfaction for the team meeting. Let me build it in the three parts — situation, facts, recommendation — so it's short and useful.

Part one, the situation. Two sentences: 'We asked our top twenty clients how happy they are with us. We wanted to know what to keep and what to improve.'

Part two, the facts. Just the key numbers, and small ones. 'Eighteen of twenty clients are happy or very happy. The two unhappy clients both mentioned the same thing: slow replies to emails.'

Part three, the recommendation. What I think we should do. 'I recommend one simple change: reply to every client email within one working day. That should fix the main complaint.'

And that's the whole report. Situation, facts, recommendation. One page. A busy manager reads it in two minutes and knows exactly what's happening and what to do.

No long story, no big words. Short sentences, small numbers, clear next step. That's a report that actually gets read.

items.q: What is the report about?
items.why: "a one-page report on client satisfaction."

items.q: What is the situation (part one)?
options: They asked their top twenty clients how happy they are
items.why: "We asked our top twenty clients how happy they are with us."

items.q: What is the key fact?
options: Eighteen of twenty are happy; the two unhappy ones mentioned slow email replies
items.why: "Eighteen of twenty clients are happy… The two unhappy clients both mentioned… slow replies to emails."

items.q: What is the recommendation?
options: Reply to every client email within one working day
items.why: "reply to every client email within one working day."

items.q: What makes it a report that gets read?
options: Short sentences, small numbers, clear next step
items.why: "Short sentences, small numbers, clear next step."

items.q: The **situation** part of a report…
items.why: Situation = situação.

items.q: A **recommendation** is…
options: what you think should be done
items.why: Recommendation = recomendação.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Let me **___** the situation in one sentence."
items.why: Describe = descrever.

items.q: To **summarise** means to…
items.why: Summarise = resumir.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A good report is short and **___**."
items.why: Clear = claro.

items.q: "A report that **gets read**." To get read means…
items.why: Gets read = é de fato lido.

items.q: "Let's **cut it down** to one page." To cut down means to…
items.why: Cut down = reduzir.

items.q: "Get **to the point**." To get to the point means to…
items.why: To the point = direto ao assunto.

items.q: "The two unhappy clients **mentioned the same thing**." To mention means to…
items.why: Mention = mencionar.

items.q: "That should **fix the main complaint**." A complaint is…
options: a statement that something is wrong
items.why: Complaint = reclamação.
